front: What is the cost of a segment in mean-shift detection?
back: The sum of squared deviations from the segment mean. Low cost means the values are close to one level.
Find the single cut with the largest gain. If gain > penalty, keep it and repeat on both sides. Else stop.
It finds the best set of change points for cost + penalty × number of cuts, using dynamic programming with pruning.

front: Why do change-point methods need a penalty?
back: Without it, every point would become its own segment, because more cuts always lower the cost.

front: Online or offline: CUSUM vs binary segmentation?
back: CUSUM is online (alarms as data arrive). Binary segmentation and PELT are offline (use the whole series).
